title: Geography
description:
A geography: FIPS key, level and a display name. The name is for display only; it is
never a key and may change spelling between sources.

level.description: Must agree with the length of `id` (2 digits = state, 5 digits = county).

GeoId.description: Geography key: state FIPS (2 digits) or county FIPS (5 digits), zero-padded
